day_shape: 64 items: Trump says no final decision yet on major Iran strikes, State/Treasury sanction Babak Zanjani evasion network, WSJ reports Bahrain and Kuwait secretly struck Iran, Yemeni missiles reported hitting Jizan, EU sanctions five Iranian judges.

threads.label: Trump weighs wider Iran strikes
threads.summary: Trump told a White House press conference he had not made a final decision on major military strikes against Iran while saying Washington was in talks with Tehran. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Bahrain and Kuwait secretly sent fighter jets to strike Iranian military sites earlier in July, and a Senate war-powers clash intensified.

threads.label: US and EU sanctions on Iran networks
threads.summary: The US State Department and Treasury designated Babak Zanjani and a network of four individuals and nine entities accused of enabling Iranian sanctions evasion and IRGC financing. The EU separately sanctioned five Iranian judges and a cyber figure, while Treasury also targeted a Muslim Brotherhood official and entities accused of moving Hamas funds.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei nuclear intent reporting
threads.summary: The New York Times reported US intelligence assessed Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is 'far more' inclined than his father to pursue nuclear weapons, carried by Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post. Iran International cited security-linked outlet Noor News saying Ali Khamenei was killed in February at a meeting on protest crackdowns and a feared US-Israeli attack.

threads.label: Yemen strikes on Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted claims and imagery of Yemeni missile and drone strikes on Jizan and reported activation of Yanbu's early-warning system, alongside claims of fuel-station queues and flight disruption in southern Saudi Arabia. The Saudi-led coalition said it struck Houthi military sites in Hodeidah, and UN Secretary-General Guterres said he was deeply alarmed by resumed Houthi Red Sea attacks.

threads.label: Iran rebuilding and Hormuz fallout
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post cited a Wall Street Journal report that satellite imagery shows Iran has rebuilt bridges and missile bases damaged by US and Israeli strikes faster than expected. Iran International reported Chinese customs data indicating Iran bore the biggest economic cost of its Strait of Hormuz closure, while IRIB posted a 'Dragon report' on the strait.

threads.label: UK, Germany respond to IRGC threats
threads.summary: Britain said its armed forces stood ready to defend the country after Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned against allowing US bombers to fly from UK bases. Germany scaled back its Tehran embassy operations and again urged citizens to leave Iran.

threads.label: Regime domestic messaging and Arbaeen
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and Defa Press posted messages framing the confrontation with the US as a war of attrition and urging trust in officials, while IRIB reported over 1.7 million pilgrims registered for Arbaeen and Iran International reported café closures in Tehran over renewed hijab enforcement. Iran International also said Pezeshkian's camp accused state TV of editing his remarks that Ali Khamenei had privately ordered US talks.
